badge_template.description: The vendor-neutral CISSP credential confirms technical knowledge and experience to design, engineer, implement, and manage the overall security posture of an organization. Required by the world’s most security-conscious organizations, CISSP is the gold-standard information security certification that assures information security leaders possess the breadth and depth of knowledge to establish holistic security programs that protect against threats in an increasingly complex cyber world.
badge_template.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

alignments.name: ISO/IEC 17024:2012
alignments.description: ISO/IEC 17024:2012 contains principles and requirements for a body certifying persons against specific requirements, and includes the development and maintenance of a certification scheme for persons.

badge_template_activities.title: Complete continuing professional education requirements
Subscribe to the Code of Ethics
Achieve a passing score on the CISSP exam
Obtain the required experience
Obtain an endorsement from an existing ISC2 member

endorsements.description: This credential has been successfully evaluated by the American Council on Education for college credit. It is recommended for a total of 3 college credits. For more information about ACE Learning Evaluations, visit www.acenet.edu.

badge_template.description: The vendor-neutral SSCP credential confirms deep technical knowledge and competency in implementing, monitoring, and administering IT Infrastructure in accordance with information security policies and requirements across the organization. The SSCP credential draws from a comprehensive, up-to-date global body of knowledge that ensures candidates have the right information security knowledge and skills to be successful in IT operational roles.
badge_template.name: Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP)

alignments.name: ISO/IEC 17024:2012
alignments.description: ISO/IEC 17024:2012 contains principles and requirements for a body certifying persons against specific requirements, and includes the development and maintenance of a certification scheme for persons.

Agree to abide by the CISM Continuing Professional Education Policy

badge_template.description: CRISC is the only certification that positions IT professionals for future career growth by linking IT risk management to enterprise risk management, and positioning them to become strategic partners to the business.
badge_template.name: Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control™ (CRISC)

alignments.name: ISO/IEC 17024:2003
alignments.description: Principles and requirements for a body certifying persons against specific requirements, and includes the development and maintenance of a certification scheme for persons.

badge_template_activities.title: A minimum of at least three (3) years of cumulative work experience performing the tasks of a CRISC professional across at least three (3) CRISC domains is required for certification
Agree to abide by the CRISC Continuing Professional Education Policy
Score a passing grade on the CRISC exam
Submit verified evidence of three years of work experience in the fields of risk management and information system (IS) control

badge_template.description: Earners of CompTIA Network Vulnerability Assessment Professional (CNVP) certification have the knowledge and skills required to scan applications and systems to identify vulnerabilities that can be used as a blueprint for improvements.
badge_template.name: CompTIA Network Vulnerability Assessment Professional – CNVP Stackable Certification

related_badge_templates.name: CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Expert – CSIE Stackable Certification
CompTIA Network Security Professional – CNSP Stackable Certification
CompTIA Security Analytics Expert – CSAE Stackable Certification

badge_template_activities.title: CompTIA Security+ ce Certification
CompTIA PenTest+ ce Certification

badge_template.description: Earners of the CompTIA PenTest+ certification have the knowledge and skills necessary to perform hands-on penetration testing to identify, exploit, report and manage vulnerabilities on a network. CompTIA PenTest+ professionals have demonstrated the hands-on ability and knowledge to find vulnerabilities in newer environments such as cloud and hybrid, web applications, embedded devices, as well as traditional desktops and servers. These skills help organizations comply to regulations.
badge_template.name: CompTIA PenTest+ ce Certification

related_badge_templates.name: CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Expert – CSIE Stackable Certification
CompTIA Network Vulnerability Assessment Professional – CNVP Stackable Certification

badge_template_activities.title: Achieve a passing score on the CompTIA PenTest+ performance-based exam.
Complete continuing education requirements for renewal
Obtain the recommended experience -- Network+ and Security+ as well as a minimum of 3-4 years of hands-on, technical information security experience.

badge_template.description: Earners of the CompTIA Security+ certification have the knowledge and skills necessary to perform core security functions required of any cybersecurity role. CompTIA Security+ professionals know how to identify and address potential threats, attacks and vulnerabilities and they have established techniques in risk management, risk mitigation, threat management and intrusion detection.
badge_template.name: CompTIA Security+ ce Certification

related_badge_templates.name: CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Expert – CSIE Stackable Certification
CompTIA Secure Cloud Professional – CSCP Stackable Certification
CompTIA Secure Infrastructure Specialist – CSIS Stackable Certification

alignments.name: Accredited by ANSI to show compliance with the ISO 17024 Standard

badge_template_activities.title: Achieve a passing score on the CompTIA Security+ performance-based exam.
Obtain the recommended experience -- CompTIA Network+ and two years of experience in IT administration with a security focus.
Complete continuing education requirements for renewal.

badge_template.description: This badge certifies completion of Cybrary's Compliance Skill Path, including all courses, challenges, and assessments.
badge_template.name: Skill Path: Compliance

badge_template_activities.title: Earn a score of 85% or higher on the assessment.
Complete all required content in the Challenge Path.
Complete all required content in the Learning Path.

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by EC-Council. The holder of this badge is capable of conducting open-source intelligence (OSINT) investigations and utilizing tools like theHarvester and Spiderfoot to gather publicly available data. They have a strong understanding of the structure of the internet and can effectively analyze and protect against potential cybersecurity threats.
badge_template.name: Open Source Intelligence

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "Open Source Intelligence", with a total course duration of 4 hours 37 minutes.

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by EC-Council. The holder of this badge is capable of understanding and implementing best practices in mobile security for both iOS and Android devices. They have knowledge of how to secure their devices, protect their personal information, and defend against potential attacks.
badge_template.name: Mobile Security

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "End to End Mobile Security", with a total course duration of 3 hours 7 minutes.

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by Apress. The holder of this badge is capable of obtaining GPS data and displaying it in the proper format using Android Studio. They can create tracking apps and other location-based apps, as well as display coordinates on a map. Suitable for advanced Android developers and beginners.
badge_template.name: Real-Time Location in Android

badge_template_activities.title: Complete at least 80% of "Real-Time Location in Android Studio: Obtaining Location Coordinates Based on GPS Data", with a total course duration of 26 minutes.
Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.

evidence.title: Full Course Title
evidence.description: Real-Time Location in Android Studio: Obtaining Location Coordinates Based on GPS Data

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by friends of ED. The holder of this badge is capable of programming iOS apps that can retrieve and display real-time GPS coordinates. They can format the coordinates for different screen sizes and incorporate them into a visually appealing map.
badge_template.name: Real Time Location in Xcode

related_badge_templates.name: JSON in Xcode: Downloading and Listing Data

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "Get Real Time Location in Xcode: Provide an iOS App with GPS Coordinates", with a total course duration of 25 minutes.

evidence.title: Full Course Title
evidence.description: Get Real Time Location in Xcode: Provide an iOS App with GPS Coordinates

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by Infinite Skills. The holder of this badge is capable of effectively diagnosing, isolating, and fixing problems in Android applications. They are skilled in passive debugging, configuring an Android virtual machine, inspecting data, and using passive inspection tools and Android unit testing.
badge_template.name: Debugging Android Apps

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "Debugging and Testing Android Applications", with a total course duration of 1 hour 55 minutes.

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by Packt Publishing. The holder of this badge is capable of simulating attacks on Android apps, identifying vulnerabilities, intercepting application traffic, analyzing app code, and implementing reverse-engineering practices using industry-standard tools.
badge_template.name: Android Bug Bounty Tests

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "The Complete Guide to Android Bug Bounty Penetration Tests", with a total course duration of 1 hour 51 minutes.

badge_template.description: Earners of the LFD121: Developing Secure Software badge know the practical steps that must be taken to counter most kinds of attacks. Using these steps, they create and maintain systems that are much harder to successfully attack, reduce the damage when attacks are successful, and speed up the response so that any latent vulnerabilities can be rapidly repaired.
badge_template.name: LFD121: Developing Secure Software

related_badge_templates.name: LFEL1006: Securing Projects with OpenSSF Scorecard

badge_template_activities.title: Score an 80% passing grade on the final exam.

badge_template.description: The holder of this badge has completed the following course by Packt Publishing. The holder of this badge is capable of distinguishing vulnerabilities, interpreting CVE records, prioritizing findings using business context, and planning patching and remediation activity.
badge_template.name: Vulnerability Management

badge_template_activities.title: Available to O'Reilly enterprise accounts and paid individual subscribers.
Complete at least 80% of "Vulnerability Management: CVSS, Vendor Patching, Risk Prioritization, and Remediation", with a total course duration of 1 hour 53 minutes.

evidence.description: Vulnerability Management: CVSS, Vendor Patching, Risk Prioritization, and Remediation
